turns.text: It's time to shine with the scotty timing. Dangerous to give the AM these windows back in the momentum game like this. It's like every time Satanic starts to almost pour ahead. 69% for Spirit. I agree, it's like a 70-30 game, kinda. Still 30 though for PV. An ideal fight is they catch this SD at the same time as Ante. The same time as Anthony.

Because they can't really save him if Ursa goes on him at the same time as one or two stuns. We saw one other Tide game with the Arcana, but that Tide owned. This Tide? Yikes. I feel like Ammar would much rather play against an Ursa. I've seen Ammar Tide against Ursa. So this ban and block pick, they know Yatora plays Anti-Mage. This is not a surprise. He's been playing it. They chose this.

I feel like Ursa matchup is easier to deal with than Anti-Mage. That's what kinda fucked him, right? Yeah, if I'm ST here I would like an Axe. I don't know, but I'm... He went Conk Reps. I get it, but it's not game winning. Cause now Tidehunter can actually kind of frontline, so... Whoa! Uh... He blinked into all of them? Alright, I guess.

Kicks him to death. That's gonna give... A bit of a nine-ass moment. Entirety of PariVision out of the upper half. They're just gonna run down the bottom... ...Disruption... Protect the Froge! ...But he does a BKB. Not much you can do here. More space, more time though. The Toro continues to clean up the waves. Yeah, they pushed Satanic back to his base. No one closer to his base. A LITTLE BIT!

Jobra, how can they win? That's a good question. I think they can still. I mean, MKB, Satanic, and a couple mistakes from Ytoro? Definitely. Theoretically though, Ursa is one of the highest win rates against Anti-Mage, so we shouldn't like... ...Pobby picked it for a reason. He knew... they were gonna pick it, so yeah. I'm thinking Amber vs Earthspirit late game impact in this game...

...I don't know. They're both gonna have a good time later, I think. I will say Lycan does not scale Giga well, but he's super farmed and he's gonna bite the... ...Anthi-Mage, right? Which is big. Almost. Moodwink trying to be cute, for sure, but not cute enough.
